text:
Lior Beres 

Hi dear Lior,

Thank you so much for your reply in the Mixed Couples Visa group 🙏🏻

I just wanted to ask you for a little more guidance, if you don’t mind. I’m a bit confused about the different steps of the process, as it has been quite a while since I went through it.

If we decide to get married, does that mean that the process would be shorter, with the B1 visa stage lasting around 6 months instead of going through the full 5-year process?

And if we are not married and diving again into this proccess for a second time ? 

If you have the time, could you please explain or summarize the full visa process for a married couple, including the different stages and approximate timeline? It would really help me understand the process again and know what to expect. 🙏🏻✨🌹

Thank you so much for your help, your time, and the amazing community that you have created.
